image-base64.desc: Gbanwee foto ka ọ bụrụ eriri Base64 iji tinye na HTML, CSS ma ọ bụ koodu, ma gbanwee Base64 laghachi na foto.

bg-remove.name: Wepụ Ndabere Foto
bg-remove.desc: Wepụ ndabere ọcha ma ọ bụ agba otu site na foto ngwaahịa, akara aha na foto onwe, ozugbo n’ngwaọrụ gị.

watermark.name: Tinye Akara Mmiri na Foto
watermark.desc: Tinye ederede, akara aha ma ọ bụ akara ikike nke onye dere na otu foto ma ọ bụ ọtụtụ foto n’otu oge.

pdf-merge.name: Jikọta na Kewaa PDF
pdf-merge.desc: Jikọta ọtụtụ faịlụ PDF n’otu, wepụta ibe ndị ị chọrọ, ma ọ bụ kewaa PDF ibe ka ibe.

pptx-pdf.name: PowerPoint ↔ PDF
pptx-pdf.desc: Gbanwee slide PowerPoint (.pptx) ka ọ bụrụ PDF ma gbanwee faịlụ PDF ka ọ bụrụ PowerPoint.

file-diff.name: Tụnyere Faịlụ Abụọ
file-diff.desc: Chọta ọdịiche dị n’etiti ederede abụọ: TXT, Word, HTML ma ọ bụ PDF nwere ederede. A na-akọwapụta akụkụ agbakwunyere, ewepụrụ na ndị agbanwere.

text-analysis.name: Nyocha Ederede
text-analysis.desc: Gụọ okwu, mkpụrụedemede, ahịrịokwu na paragraf, tụọ oge ọgụgụ na ọnụ ọgụgụ okwu isi maka ederede, TXT, Word ma ọ bụ faịlụ PDF.

data-convert.name: Gbanwee JSON, XML, CSV, Excel
data-convert.desc: Gbanwee data n’etiti JSON, XML, CSV na Excel (.xlsx) na ngosi tebụl.

bmi-bmr.name: Ngwa BMI na BMR
bmi-bmr.desc: Gbakọọ ọnụọgụ ibu ahụ (BMI), ruru úkwù na ọkpụkpụ úkwù na ọnụ ọgụgụ kalori achọrọ (BMR, TDEE) site n’afọ, mmekọ nwoke na nwanyị na ọkwa mmega ahụ.

meal-calo.name: Atụmatụ Nri na Kalori Kwa Ụbọchị
meal-calo.desc: Hazie nri site n’ebumnuche kalori, lelee kalori nke nri ndị a na-ahụkarị ma kwekọọ protein, carbs na abụba.

water-tracker.name: Nleba Anya Mmiri Ị Nụrụ
water-tracker.desc: Setịa ebumnuche kwa ụbọchị ma dee ole mmiri ị nụrụ, na ọganihu na akụkọ ọtụtụ ụbọchị.

calo-burn.name: Kalori A Hụrụ Site na Mmega Ahụ
calo-burn.desc: Tụọ kalori a hụrụ site n’egwuregwu, mmega ahụ, oge na ịdị arọ ahụ site na ụkpụrụ MET.

cycle-track.name: Nleba Anya Usoro Ọnwa
cycle-track.desc: Dee ma buo amụma usoro ọnwa gị, ụbọchị ovulation na oge ịtụrụ ime. Data na-anọgide naanị n’ngwaọrụ gị.

study-timetable.name: Usoro Oge Ọmụmụ
study-timetable.desc: Mepụta usoro oge klaasị kwa izu site n’oge; bipụta ya ma ọ bụ chekwaa ya iji ya kwa ụbọchị.

quiz-bank.name: Ajụjụ na Ụlọ Akụ Ajụjụ
quiz-bank.desc: Mepụta ụlọ akụ ajụjụ nwere nhọrọ ọtụtụ, gbagwoo ajụjụ, were nnwale omume nwere akara, ma bipụta ule na azịza.

attendance.name: Ndebanye Ọnụ
attendance.desc: Mepụta ndepụta klaasị, debanye ndị bịarutere n’oge ọ bụla ma soro ndị na-adịghị ya na ndị bịara ọgbụgba. Nwere ike ikwekọrịta na Google Sheets.

mindmap.name: Eserese Echiche na Nchịkọta
mindmap.desc: Dee eserese echiche maka ihe ọmụmụ ma jiri onwe ya chịkọta ederede toro ogologo n’isi ihe.

teaching-pay.name: Awa Nkuzi na Ụgwọ
teaching-pay.desc: Dee oge nkuzi, gbakọọ awa na ụgwọ site n’ọnụ ahịa, ma wepụta nkwupụta.

fullscreen-clock.name: Elekere Ihuenyo Zuru Ezu
fullscreen-clock.desc: Elekere dijitalụ buru ibu n’ihuenyo zuru ezu nwere stopwatch na ọnụ ọgụgụ ọdịda, agba, mkpụrụedemede na ụdị awa 12/24 nwere ike ịhazi.

countdown-video.name: Ihe Na-emepụta Vidiyo Ọnụ Ọgụgụ Ọdịda
countdown-video.desc: Mepụta ihe ọnụ ọgụgụ ọdịda nwere ike ịhazi ma budata ya dị ka vidiyo iji tinye na vidiyo gị.

world-clock.name: Elekere Ụwa
world-clock.desc: Lee oge dị ugbu a n’ọtụtụ obodo n’otu oge ma tụnyere ọdịiche mpaghara oge dị n’etiti ha.

workdays.name: Ngwa Mgbakọ Ụbọchị Ọrụ
workdays.desc: Gụọ ụbọchị ọrụ dị n’etiti ụbọchị abụọ, wepụ Satọde, Sọnde na ezumike ọha.

journal.name: Akwụkwọ Ndekọ n’Ịntanetị
journal.desc: Dee akwụkwọ ndekọ kwa ụbọchị echekwara nzuzo na Google Sheet nke gị, naanị gị nwere ike ịgụ ya.

code-format.name: Hazie JS, HTML, CSS, JSON
code-format.desc: Hazie ma dozie koodu JavaScript, HTML, CSS na JSON nke ọma.

code-check.name: Ihe Nlele Usoro
code-check.desc: Chọta njehie usoro na nhazi na JavaScript, HTML, CSS na JSON, na ahịrị na kọlụm.

js-obfuscate.name: Ihe Na-ezo Ezo JavaScript
js-obfuscate.desc: Debe eriri, gbanwee aha mgbanwe ma zoo JavaScript ka ọ sie ike ịgụ na ịkọpịa.

rsa-keys.name: Igodo RSA na Nzo Ezo
rsa-keys.desc: Mepụta nke abụọ igodo RSA (PEM), zoo ederede site n’igodo ọha ma kọwaa ya site n’igodo nzuzo, niile n’ngwaọrụ gị.

text-to-html.name: Ederede Ọgaranya gaa HTML
text-to-html.desc: Dezie n’anya site n’ederede ọkpụrụkpụ, isi okwu, ndepụta, tebụl na njikọ, ma nweta koodu HTML dị ọcha.

inventory.name: Ngwongwo na Ọnụ Ahịa
inventory.desc: Setịa ọnụ ahịa ire site n’ụgwọ ahịa, mgbasa ozi na uru. Soro ngwongwo na-abata na na-apụ na ọkwa ngwongwo dị ntakịrị.

invoice.name: Invoyis na Quote
invoice.desc: Mepụta quote na invoyis ire nwere akara aha, mkpokọta na-akpaghị aka na ego e dere n’okwu. Bipụta ma ọ bụ chekwaa dị ka PDF.

menu-qr.name: Menu QR
menu-qr.desc: Mepụta menu dijitalụ maka ụlọ nri na kafe. Ndị ahịa na-asa koodu QR ka ha hụ nri na ọnụ ahịa.

barcode.name: Ihe Na-emepụta Barcode
barcode.desc: Mepụta barcode Code 128, EAN-13, EAN-8, UPC-A na Code 39 maka akara ngwaahịa na ụlọ nchekwa.

loan.name: Ngwa Mgbakọ Mgbazinye
loan.desc: Ịkwụ ụgwọ kwa ọnwa, mkpokọta ọmụrụ na usoro ịkwụ ụgwọ maka mgbazinye ụlọ, ụgbọ ala na mgbazinye ndị ahịa.

compound.name: Ọmụrụ Agbakwunyere na Nkwakọba Ego
compound.desc: Tụọ ego ị ga-akpokọta site na nkwakọba ego ma ọ bụ itinye ego kwa ọnwa.

salary.name: Ụgwọ Ọnwa Gross ↔ Net
salary.desc: Gbanwee ụgwọ ọnwa Gross gaa Net na ịlaghachi, soro iwu 2026 nke mkpuchi na ụtụ isi ego onye (Vietnam).

qr-code.name: Ihe Na-emepụta QR Code
qr-code.desc: Mepụta QR code maka njikọ, ederede, Wi‑Fi, email na ọnụ ọgụgụ ekwentị. Budata dị ka PNG ma ọ bụ SVG.

utm.name: Ihe Na-ewu Njikọ UTM
utm.desc: Tinye koodu nsochi mgbasa ozi na njikọ ka ị hụ ọwa ndị ọbịa gị si abịa.

colors.name: Mpempe Agba na Koodu
colors.desc: Mepụta mpempe agba kwekọrọ site n’agba mbụ ma nweta koodu HEX, RGB, HSL na mgbanwe CSS.

expense.name: Mmefu na Mmefu Ego
expense.desc: Dee ego na-abata na mmefu kwa ụbọchị, lee mmefu site na ụdị ma setịa oke ka ị nọgide n’ime mmefu ego.

habit.name: Nleba Anya Omume na Usoro Ụbọchị
habit.desc: Kaa omume ọ bụla kwa ụbọchị ma soro usoro ụbọchị na-esochi onwe ya ka ị nọgide n’ịdị aka ike.

cv.name: Ihe Na-ewu Akwụkwọ CV
cv.desc: Dejupụta ndebiri nwere ngosi dị ndụ, họrọ nhazi na agba, ma bipụta ma ọ bụ chekwaa dị ka PDF n’efu.

currency-time.name: Ego na Mpaghara Oge
currency-time.desc: Gbanwee ego site n’ọnụ ahịa kachasị ọhụrụ ma lelee oge n’obodo dị gburugburu ụwa.

image-resize.name: Ihe Na-agbanwe Nha Foto
image-resize.desc: Gbanwee nha foto site na pikselụ ma ọ bụ pasent, debe nha kwekọrọ ma hazie ọtụtụ foto n’otu oge.

image-crop.name: Bipụ Foto
image-crop.desc: Bipụ foto n’efu ma ọ bụ na 1:1, 4:3, 16:9 na 9:16, ma tụgharịa ma ọ bụ gbanwee tupu ibudata.

image-ocr.name: Foto gaa Ederede (OCR)
image-ocr.desc: Wepụta ederede site na foto, foto ihuenyo na akwụkwọ a saara. Na-akwado Bekee na asụsụ 30+ ndị ọzọ.

heic-jpg.name: HEIC gaa JPG
heic-jpg.desc: Gbanwee foto HEIC nke iPhone gaa JPG ma ọ bụ PNG ka ha mepee n’ebe ọ bụla. Na-akwado mgbanwe ọtụtụ.

image-upscale.name: Ihe Na-eme Foto Ka Ọ Buo Ibu AI
image-upscale.desc: Mee ka foto buo ibu 2× ma ọ bụ 4× ma mee ka nkọwa doo anya site na AI. Dị mma maka obere foto, ndị na-adịghị ọcha ma ọ bụ ndị ochie.

image-to-pdf.name: Foto gaa PDF
image-to-pdf.desc: Jikọta foto JPG na PNG n’otu PDF, tụgharịa ibe ma họrọ nha akwụkwọ na ókè.

pdf-to-image.name: PDF gaa Foto
pdf-to-image.desc: Gbanwee ibe PDF ọ bụla ka ọ bụrụ JPG ma ọ bụ PNG doro anya, họrọ nkọwa, budata foto otu otu ma ọ bụ ZIP.

pdf-compress.name: Pịa PDF
pdf-compress.desc: Belata nha faịlụ PDF maka email na ụdị n’ịntanetị. Họrọ ọkwa nkpagharị ma tụnyere nha.

pdf-to-word.name: PDF gaa Word
pdf-to-word.desc: Gbanwee PDF gaa faịlụ Word (.docx) nwere ike idezi na-edebe ederede na paragraf, ma ọ bụ debe nhazi ibe dị ka foto.

word-to-pdf.name: Word gaa PDF
word-to-pdf.desc: Gbanwee faịlụ Word (.docx) gaa PDF n’ihe nchọgharị gị, lelee, wee budata ma ọ bụ bipụta.

pdf-sign.name: Binye PDF Aka
pdf-sign.desc: Dee ma ọ bụ pịnye ndebanye aka gị, tinye ndebanye aka foto na ụbọchị, tinye ya na ibe PDF ma budata.

pdf-edit.name: Dezie PDF na Jupụta Ụdị
pdf-edit.desc: Tinye ederede, akara nlele na igbe mkpuchi na PDF ma jupụta ebe ụdị dị adị.

case-convert.name: Ihe Na-agbanwe Mkpụrụedemede Ukwu/Obere
case-convert.desc: Gbanwee ederede gaa UPPERCASE, lowercase, Title Case, Sentence case, camelCase, snake_case na ndị ọzọ.

fancy-text.name: Ihe Na-emepụta Ederede Mara Mma
fancy-text.desc: Gbanwee ederede nkịtị gaa mkpụrụedemede mara mma 30+ maka Instagram, TikTok, bio Facebook na aha egwuregwu. Kọpịa n’otu pịa.

text-to-speech.name: Ederede gaa Olu
text-to-speech.desc: Gụọ ederede n’olu elu site n’olu ngwaọrụ gị. Họrọ olu, ọsọ na ịdị elu olu. Na-akwado ọtụtụ asụsụ.

speech-to-text.name: Olu gaa Ederede
speech-to-text.desc: Dee site n’olu gị: kwuo okwu n’ime maikrofon ma hụ ederede na-apụta ozugbo, wee kọpịa ya ma ọ bụ budata ya.

scientific-calc.name: Ngwa Mgbakọ Sayensị
scientific-calc.desc: Ngwa mgbakọ n’ịntanetị nwere trigonometry, logarithm, ike, mgbọrọgwụ, factorial, degrees/radians, ebe nchekwa na akụkọ.

percentage.name: Ngwa Mgbakọ Pasent
percentage.desc: Chọta X% nke Y, pasent X bụ nke Y, mgbanwe pasent na ọnụ ahịa ịlaa ahịa, na usoro nzọụkwụ site na nzọụkwụ.

unit-convert.name: Ihe Na-agbanwe Nkeji
unit-convert.desc: Gbanwee ogologo, ịdị arọ, okpomọkụ, mpaghara, olu, ọsọ, oge, data, nrụgide na ume.

age-calc.name: Ngwa Mgbakọ Afọ
age-calc.desc: Gbakọọ afọ ziri ezi n’afọ, ọnwa na ụbọchị, ngụkọta ụbọchị ị biri, ụbọchị ọmụmụ na-esote na akara zodiac.

date-calc.name: Ngwa Mgbakọ Ụbọchị
date-calc.desc: Gụọ ụbọchị dị n’etiti ụbọchị abụọ, tinye ma ọ bụ wepụ ụbọchị, izu, ọnwa na afọ, ma hụ ụbọchị izu.

gpa.name: Ngwa Mgbakọ GPA
gpa.desc: Gbakọọ GPA nke semesta na nke nchikọta site na kredit n’ọnụ ọgụgụ 4.0 nwere mkpụrụedemede akara.

due-date.name: Ngwa Mgbakọ Ụbọchị Ọmụmụ
due-date.desc: Tụọ ụbọchị ọmụmụ na izu ime site n’oge ọnwa ikpeazụ, ụbọchị ịtụrụ ime ma ọ bụ ultrasound, na ihe mgbaàmà bụ isi.

spin-wheel.name: Gbagharịa Wheel
spin-wheel.desc: Mepụta wheel nwere aha ma ọ bụ onyinye ọ bụla, gbagharịa n’ụzọ ziri ezi n’ahaziri, wepụ ndị mmeri, ọnọdụ ihuenyo zuru ezu.

random-number.name: Ihe Na-emepụta Ọnụọgụ Ahaziri
random-number.desc: Mepụta ọnụọgụ ahaziri n’oke ọ bụla, ọtụtụ n’otu oge, na ma ọ bụ na-enweghị nkwugharị, maka ịdọrọ aha na egwuregwu.

typing-test.name: Nnwale Ọsọ Ide
typing-test.desc: Tụọ ọsọ ide gị (WPM) na izi ezi n’oge sekọnd 30 ruo nkeji 5.

cps-test.name: Nnwale CPS (Ọsọ Ịpị)
cps-test.desc: Gụọ ịpị n’sekọnd site na sekọnd 1 ruo 60, debe akara kacha mma gị, nwalee spacebar na mmetụ aka.

webcam-test.name: Nnwale Webcam
webcam-test.desc: Lelee ma igwefoto gị na-arụ ọrụ, hụ nkọwa na ọsọ fureemu, gbanwee igwefoto ma were foto nnwale.

screen-recorder.name: Ihe Na-edekọ Ihuenyo
screen-recorder.desc: Dekọọ ihuenyo gị, windo ma ọ bụ taabụ na ụda sistemu na maikrofon, enweghị mwụnye.

video-compress.name: Ihe Na-apị Vidiyo
video-compress.desc: Belata faịlụ MP4, MOV na WebM maka ozi, email na mgbasa ozi mmekọrịta. Họrọ nkọwa na àgwà.

video-to-mp3.name: Vidiyo gaa MP3
video-to-mp3.desc: Wepụta ụda site na vidiyo MP4, MOV na WebM dị ka MP3, họrọ àgwà ma bipụ akụkụ ị chọrọ.

guitar-tuner.name: Ihe Na-edozi Gita
guitar-tuner.desc: Dozie gita, ukulele na bass site na maikrofon gị: nọtụ, ọdịiche cents na agịga, tinyere ụda ntụnye aka.

password-gen.name: Ihe Na-emepụta Paswọọdụ
password-gen.desc: Mepụta paswọọdụ siri ike ahaziri ma ọ bụ okwu paswọọdụ ndị a ga-echeta, họrọ ogologo na mkpụrụedemede, lelee ike.

signature.name: Ihe Na-emepụta Ndebanye Aka
signature.desc: Seere ndebanye aka gị site na mọọsụ ma ọ bụ mkpịsị aka, ma ọ bụ dee ya n’mkpụrụedemede aka; budata PNG doro anya.

logo-maker.name: Ihe Na-emepụta Akara Aha
logo-maker.desc: Mepụta akara aha site n’akara, aha ika na slogan; họrọ mkpụrụedemede, agba na nhazi, budata SVG ma ọ bụ PNG.

notepad.name: Akwụkwọ Ndetu n’Ịntanetị
notepad.desc: Ndetu ngwa ngwa na-echekwa onwe ya n’ihe nchọgharị gị: ọtụtụ ndetu, nchọta, ọnụ ọgụgụ okwu na ibudata TXT.

excel-word-fill.name: Jupụta Word site na Excel
excel-word-fill.desc: Were ọdịnaya site na faịlụ Excel tinye ya n'akara faịlụ Word, na-egosi isiokwu nwere nọmba n'agba uhie.

excel-cell-merge.name: Jikọta cell Excel site na ọtụtụ sheet / faịlụ
excel-cell-merge.desc: Jikọta otu cell (A1, B2...) site na ọtụtụ sheet ma ọ bụ faịlụ Excel n'otu, na ịdọ aka ná ntị maka cell nwere data n'ihe karịrị otu isi mmalite.

excel-row-concat.name: Chịkọta ahịrị Excel site na ọtụtụ sheet / faịlụ
excel-row-concat.desc: Chịkọta ọtụtụ sheet ma ọ bụ faịlụ Excel n'ụzọ ugwu n'otu tebụl ogologo. Debe isi otu ugboro ma hapụ ahịrị efu.

excel-formula-merge.name: Jikọta data Excel na fọmula
excel-formula-merge.desc: Jikọta ọtụtụ sheet ma ọ bụ faịlụ Excel na fọmula n'otu n'otu cell (SUM, IF, CONCAT, UNIQUE...), ọrụ dị n'ime ọrụ ọzọ, na fọmula echekwara i nwere ike iji ọzọ.

sudoku-9x9.name: Sudoku 9x9
sudoku-9x9.desc: Kpọọ Sudoku 9x9 n'ịntanetị n'ọkwa 10 site n'ọdịnihu ruo ọnụ ọgụ, nwere ndetu, ntụnye aka na nyocha njehie.

sudoku-16x16.name: Sudoku 16x16
sudoku-16x16.desc: Sudoku buru ibu 16x16 na-eji 1-9 na A-G, ọkwa 10 site n'ọdịnihu ruo ọnụ ọgụ, nwere ndetu na ntụnye aka.

chess.name: Chess megide kọmputa
chess.desc: Kpọọ chess megide kọmputa n'ọkwa 10 site n'ọdịnihu ruo ọnụ ọgụ, nwere castling, en passant na mmelite.

xiangqi.name: Xiangqi megide kọmputa
xiangqi.desc: Kpọọ chess China (xiangqi) megide kọmputa n'ọkwa 10, nwere mgbochi ụkwụ inyinya, anya enyí, ijide egbe na iwu ndị agha na-eche ihu.

go-game.name: Go megide kọmputa
go-game.desc: Kpọọ Go megide kọmputa n'elu bọọdụ 5x5, 7x7 na 9x9 n'ọkwa 10, nwere ọgụgụ akara onwe ya na njedebe.

memory-shapes.name: Ebe nchekwa ọdịdị na agba

N’ihi na RSA nwere ike izo naanị data dị mkpụmkpụ nke ukwuu ozugbo, ngwa a na-eji nzo ezo agwakọtara: ọ na-emepụta igodo AES ahaziri ahazi iji zoo ederede, wee jiri RSA kechie igodo AES ahụ — ya mere a pụrụ izo ederede ọ bụla n’ogologo.
